title: KPT in verbs
focus: Use familiar strong-to-weak KPT changes in common minä forms; no strengthening patterns are included.

exercises.prompt: nukkua (“to sleep”) → minä ____ (“I sleep”) · add minä -n
exercises.explanation: nukkua means “to sleep”; nukun means “I sleep”. This is the minä-form of nukkua. Add the minä ending -n after forming the stem. kk weakens to k.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Minä verb forms with KPT: form not yet correct
